extraction_notes: Tables extracted with pdftotext -layout; curves digitized from 400 dpi pdftoppm renders by per-column blue-pixel cluster analysis with axis frames located from black-pixel runs (Fig1/Fig3 p. 3, Fig7 p. 4).

P-channel quantities: datasheet plots -VGS/-VDS/-ID axes; curve points are stored as magnitudes per the mosfet context pack, and table spec values keep the datasheet's negative signs (VDS = -60 V, ID = -2 A device).

Digitization cross-check against the p. 2 table at |VDS| = 30 V: Ciss 308 vs 310 pF, Coss 22.4 vs 22 pF, Crss 16.0 vs 15 pF typ; RDS(ON) typ 0.15 ohm implies about 3.3 A at |VDS| = 0.5 V, consistent with the Fig1 linear-region bundle.
Fig3 transfer curve: 25 degC solid trace digitized; the figure does not state the VDS clamp used; the 125 degC dashed trace was excluded (black dashes, not captured by the blue filter).

Fig1 output curves: only the four unambiguous traces extracted (VGS = -10 V topmost envelope, and the individually labelled -4.5 V, -4 V, -3 V traces); VGS = -9...-5 V traces omitted below |VDS| = 2 V the bundle merges and cluster identity is not reliable, so -10 V points start at 1.5 V and labelled traces at 2 V (except -3 V, separated from 0.5 V).
Fig7 Coss/Crss merge within pixel resolution above |VDS| = 50 V, so those series stop at 50 V; text-label pixel artifacts (legend and curve labels) were identified and excluded from clusters.

Fig5 body-diode forward curve, Fig6 SOA, Fig8 gate charge and Fig9 transient thermal impedance were examined but not digitized; body-diode and gate-charge scalars are available in the p. 2 tables (Qg 5.4 nC, Qgs 1.1 nC, Qgd 1.6 nC typ at VDS = -30 V, ID = -2 A, VGS = -10 V).
Public datasheet evidence only (www.born-tw.com, Revision 2018); no vendor SPICE or model packs consulted.

Units retry 2026-08-10: all capacitance quantities (specs ciss/coss/crss and the three capacitance-curve y series) re-encoded in SI farads (e.g. 310e-12 F for the datasheet's 310 pF) for the conveyor catalog cross-check; datasheet prints pF, values unchanged in magnitude.
